exposure: timing of intravenous oxytocin administration (before vs after suction curettage)
outcome: risk for perioperative blood loss amount of >=100 mL
cohort: The study participants were 146 patients with ultrasound-confirmed first-trimester missed abortion who underwent suction curettage with IV oxytocin administration.
finding: Compared with late-oxytocin administration, early-oxytocin administration significantly reduced perioperative blood loss during first-trimester suction curettage for missed abortion.
